gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: left-sided headache. Generated CC mentions throbbing headache and duration but not side.
Gold: headache started yesterday morning. Generated hpi-001: started yesterday morning upon waking. Start time is captured, with extra detail about waking.
Gold: headache is intermittent. No generated fact mentions intermittency/episodic nature.
Gold: non-positional. No generated fact comments on positional change or lack thereof.
Gold: improves when lying down. No generated fact addresses improvement with lying down.
Gold: has not awakened patient from sleep. No generated fact discusses waking from sleep.
Gold: worse with light (photophobia). Generated hpi-002 and hpi-003 describe sensitivity to light and worsening in light environments.
Gold: has taken paracetamol only for relief. Generated med-002 just states patient is taking paracetamol, without the 'only' qualifier for this headache.
Gold: menstrual period stopped last week. No generated fact mentions menstrual history.
Gold: no previous history of headaches. Generated hpi-005 states no prior history of headaches.
Gold: denies altered smell or taste. Generated hpi-004: no abnormal smells or tastes, but also incorrectly places this in HPI and adds other items; the smell/taste portion is covered.
Gold: eating and drinking normally. No generated fact comments on appetite or intake.
Gold: denies prodromal illness. No generated fact mentions prodromal illness.
Gold: denies viral symptoms. No generated fact addresses viral symptoms.
Gold: sore ears and coryzal symptoms. No generated fact includes these symptoms.
Gold: does not feel feverish but has not checked temperature. No generated ROS or HPI fact mentions perceived fever or temperature checking.
Gold: denies nausea and vomiting. Generated hpi-004 includes 'no ... nausea or vomiting.'
Gold: denies tingling, numbness, weakness, or rash. Generated facts do not mention these negatives.
Gold: no alteration in vision. Generated hpi-004: 'no ocular symptoms' which reasonably implies no vision change but is less specific and bundles other content.
Gold: no significant past medical history. Generated pmh-001: no significant past medical or surgical history. PMH portion is covered; PSH is added.
Gold: takes Microgynon OCP. Generated med-001: taking Microgynon.
Gold: no side effects from Microgynon. No generated fact states absence of side effects.
Gold: paracetamol only for current headache. Generated med-002 only says taking paracetamol, not that it is the only analgesic used for this headache.
Gold: allergic to aspirin (no reaction type specified). Generated allergy-001: allergic to aspirin, causes nausea. Allergy to aspirin is covered; reaction detail is added.
Gold: mother has hypertension. Generated fh-001: mother with history of hypertension.
Gold: mother has migraines. Generated fh-002: mother with migraine history.
Gold: lives with flatmates. Generated sh-001: lives with housemates (equivalent concept).
Gold: a few glasses of wine at weekends. Generated sh-002: drinks alcohol occasionally. Captures alcohol use but loses the more specific weekend pattern and quantity.
Gold: non-smoker. Generated sh-003: non-smoker.
Gold: some recent stress at work. Generated hpi-006: recent stress at work.

Gold: BP was normal when checked for last prescription (indicates a past normal BP check). Generated pf-001: patient has not had a recent BP check. This directly conflicts regarding recent BP history.

Gold: impression is tension headache vs first-episode migraine. Generated asm-001: likely migraine (no tension headache differential), which overcommits and contradicts the dual-consideration impression.
Gold: no features suggestive of meningitic illness. No generated fact mentions ruling out meningitis or similar illness.
Gold: advised to get BP checked. Generated plan-004: 'check BP' included in plan. The thermometer portion is added detail.
Gold: advised to have temperature checked. Generated plan-004 only says 'consider home thermometer', which is weaker and not clearly equivalent to actually having temperature checked.

Gold: start regular ibuprofen with food. Generated plan-001: take anti-inflammatories with paracetamol. This implies an NSAID but does not specify ibuprofen or 'regular' dosing, and mentions concurrent paracetamol. Partially aligned but key specifics are missing/changed.
Gold: advised to keep well hydrated. Generated plan-002: ensure adequate hydration.

Gold: call straight back if worsening/persistent headache/fever/rash/new symptoms. Generated plan-003: contact if headache worsens or if new symptoms such as fever or rash develop. 'Persistent' is omitted, and this is framed as plan, but core warning signs are covered.
Gold: review if headaches become regular. No generated fact mentions review if headaches become regular/recurrent.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only notes left-sided headache since yesterday. Generated adds 'throbbing' and explicitly '1-day duration'; side is not included, but nothing contradicts gold.
Supported by hpi-001 (yesterday morning) but adds 'upon waking', which is not in gold.
Left-sided and photophobia are supported by cc-001 and hpi-006; 'throbbing' quality is not present in gold but does not contradict.
Worsens with light aligns with hpi-006; 'intensity varies' is not specified in gold but does not conflict.

No abnormal smells/tastes supported by ros-001; no nausea/vomiting supported by ros-007; 'no ocular symptoms' is broader than gold ros-009 (no vision alteration) but not contradictory. Placement in HPI vs ROS is structural, not factual.
Directly matches gold statement of no previous headache history.
Matches gold social history of some recent stress at work, though tagged under HPI.
No significant past medical history is supported by pmh-001; inclusion of surgical history and admission/operation detail is additional.
Gold does not mention recent hospital admissions or operations; this is new but not contradictory.
Gold: Microgynon. Generated: taking Microgynon.

Gold med-003/hpi-007 specify 'paracetamol only' for current headache. Generated simply states 'is taking paracetamol', missing the 'only' qualifier but not contradicting it; it is an incomplete but not opposing statement.
Gold: aspirin allergy only. Generated adds reaction type 'causes nausea', which is extra detail.
Matches maternal hypertension.
Matches maternal migraine history.
Housemates = flatmates; same concept.
Gold: a few glasses of wine at weekends. Generated: occasional alcohol. This is a vaguer description that does not contradict the more specific gold detail.
Non-smoker matches gold.
Gold does not address illicit drug use; stating 'no illicit drug use' is an addition.
Generated: no recent BP check. Gold: BP was normal when checked for last prescription (implies a recent check). These statements directly conflict about recent BP history.

Generated: likely migraine. Gold: impression is tension headache vs first-episode migraine. Labeling it as 'likely migraine' overrules the diagnostic uncertainty and omits tension headache, contradicting the gold assessment framing.

Throbbing, left-sided, photophobia, no prior history are consistent with gold (cc-001, hpi-006, hpi-009), but gold does not explicitly summarize them this way in the Assessment. This is a synthesized, non-contradictory addition.

Gold plan-003: start regular ibuprofen with food. Generated: take anti-inflammatories with paracetamol. This is less specific (class not drug; no 'regular') and adds concurrent paracetamol. It diverges from the exact gold instruction but does not assert the opposite, so it is best classified as a modified addition rather than a strict contradiction.
Equivalent to 'keep well hydrated'.

Supported by fu-001 regarding contacting if headache worsens or fever/rash/new symptoms develop. However, gold also includes 'persistent headache' and follow-up if headaches become regular (fu-002), which are omitted in this generated plan. Core safety net is present but incomplete.

Gold plan-001/002 advise getting BP and temperature checked. Generated adds 'consider use of a home thermometer'; BP check portion is supported, but specifying 'home thermometer' is new and weaker than a direct instruction to have temperature checked.
